verdict.headline: Wednesday's CPI data will confirm or undo the week's record-setting equity rally
verdict.label: HOLD — 1 of 6 breached: 30Y ~5.10%; Sept hike ~35% (Kalshi post-NFP); SPX futures +0.25% at 7,779.75; WTI $78.18 within $0.82 of $79 trigger; July CPI Wednesday Aug 12 is the week's resolving binary
verdict.rationale_short: The framework holds at 1 of 6 breached (30Y ~5.10%) heading into the week, with Friday's July NFP shock (-23K vs +83K consensus) now fully absorbed: SPX closed at a record 7,774 Friday (+0.62%), Nasdaq at 26,690.62 (+1.3%), and September hike odds compressed to ~35% (Kalshi). Sunday futures extend the calm: ESU26 +0.25% at 7,779.75 with no incremental weekend risk event. BTC holds at $64,967 (Crypto.com, 11:01 AM UTC), keeping the Gate 2 buffer at ~$2,967 above the $62,000 trigger. WTI at $78.18 is the regime watch-item: it sits $0.82 from the $79 trigger, and the Hormuz deal remains in 'close but conditions unmet' status — Iran's FM Araghchi said Aug 8 that reopening the strait is 'subject to other conditions,' with US navigation-term concessions still outstanding. The sole directional event this week is Wednesday's July CPI (8:30 AM ET, Aug 12): June came in at +2.9% YoY headline and +3.2% core. A July print at or below those levels drops September hike odds toward 15-20%, eliminates the probability of a 30Y breach deepening above 5.20%, and warrants a buy upgrade. A hot print (+3.2%+ headline, +3.5%+ core) re-escalates September odds back toward 55%+, pushes the 30Y above 5.20%, and turns Friday's record closes into an air pocket heading into the Aug 20 SPCX tranche unlock.

trade_setups.asset: July CPI — Wednesday August 12, 8:30 AM ET
trade_setups.thesis: The NFP miss has reset the rate-hike debate, making Wednesday's July CPI the binary for September. June came in at +2.9% YoY headline, +3.2% core. A July print at or below those levels drops September hike odds from ~35% toward 15-20% — the de facto 'hold through year-end' signal that should extend SPX records toward 7,850 and may formally end the 30Y breach (yield falls below 5.00%), delivering 0-of-6 status for the first time since May. A hot print (+3.2%+ headline or +3.5%+ core) re-escalates September odds back toward 55%+, pushes the 30Y above 5.20%, and unwinds the week's record closes in 1-2 sessions.
trade_setups.entry: Hold into Wednesday. Watch the 30Y pre-CPI (~5.10% currently): a rise above 5.20% before the print signals bond markets pre-pricing a hot read. DXY at 99.2 is the secondary lead — a move above 100.50 post-CPI confirms rate re-escalation.
trade_setups.invalidation: CPI in-line (within ±0.1% of June levels) leaves September unresolved and the framework at 1-of-6 through the Aug 27 Jackson Hole keynote (Warsh) — base case extends without directional resolution.
trade_setups.horizon: 3 days (through July CPI, Wednesday August 12, 8:30 AM ET)

bear_case: A hot July CPI print Wednesday (Aug 12) is the primary risk: headline +3.2%+ or core +3.5%+ re-escalates September hike odds from 35% to 55%+ in a single session, pushes the 30Y above 5.20% (deepening the sole breach), and turns Friday's record SPX close at 7,774 into an air pocket heading into the Aug 20 SPCX tranche unlock. The secondary risk is the Hormuz deal's fragility: Iran's conditional stance (US navigation concessions still outstanding as of Aug 8) means a retraction pushes WTI above $79 and Brent above $85 simultaneously, activating a second regime breach (2-of-6) independent of CPI. The tertiary risk is that 921,000 July temporary layoffs signal a cycle turn rather than a one-off miss — if August employment confirms the July print, Q3 earnings revisions follow and the SPX record at 7,774 becomes the peak, not a base. If SPX loses the 7,600 level on a daily close before Wednesday's CPI, the hold thesis does not extend.
